aoi-sa.title: Quantum18 1.8GHz System Amplifier Installation and Operation Guide
aoi-sa.applicability: Quantum18 GainMaker-form-factor HGD and HGBT; exact installed split and firmware must match. Does not establish LE or BA instructions.
aoi-sa.sections: Chapter 3, Balancing and Setup: printed p37 introduction; pp38–41 preparation/firmware/configuration; pp44–45 downstream auto/manual alignment. Upstream section exact pages require confirmation from the complete matching guide.
workflow: Connect QuantumLink Local interface and verify firmware/device information.
Verify installed diplex configuration, device location and approved pilot/profile settings.
Store downstream profile, run DS auto alignment, and check the resulting levels.
Use manual adjustment only after auto alignment; apply changes and Save Configuration to retain them.
Follow matching upstream guide and local sweep reference; record saved configuration and measured results.
gaps: Direct PDF fetch failed in native reader and local environment; manufacturer PDF contents were retrieved through its indexed text. Manufacturer page currently requests installation-guide access.
Do not infer arbitrary pilots or accepted field levels from this guide.

gm-sa.title: 1 GHz GainMaker Broadband Amplifier Platform System Amplifier Modules and Housings Installation and Operation Guide
gm-sa.applicability: Internal title and text identify 1GHz HGD, LGD, UBT, HGBT, HO and GaN; mirror page title misleadingly says 870MHz. Match actual module, split, output and control module.
gm-sa.sections: Printed p3 types/splits; p9 RF test points; pp48–71 forward balancing; pp72–77 reverse balancing.
workflow: Verify design print, correct module, signal director, control option and valid input.
Use the guide section matching thermal, manual or conventional single-pilot AGC.
Balance input/output tilt and levels at the designated points; account for uncorrected -20dB test-point coupling once.
For conventional AGC only, choose model-specific AGC pad and match AGC output to setup output after settling.
Balance reverse against an established receive reference and restore design pads; retain local sweep procedure.
gaps: The archived copy is not a newly verified live manufacturer-hosted PDF.
ACI DSIM installation replaces the conventional AGC-specific steps; do not combine pad rules.

gm-le.title: 1 GHz GainMaker Broadband Amplifier Platform Line Extender Modules and Housings Installation and Operation Guide
gm-le.revision: OL-31155-01, 2014; older manufacturer landing page identifies 4009927 Rev D
gm-le.applicability: 1GHz GainMaker LE; manual, thermal and AGC variants need matching chapter.
gm-le.sections: Chapter 3: preparation pp42–46; AGC/manual setup pp47–55; AGC/thermal setup pp56–62; thermal compensation pp63–69; manual stations pp70–71; reverse pp74–79. Mirrors may retain inconsistent index page references.
workflow: Match module,split,control option and design print; verify valid input and warm-up.
Choose the exact AGC/manual,AGC/thermal,thermal-only or manual-station procedure.
For conventional AGC/manual setup,use S1=2 and the documented temperature/frequency backoff chart.
Adjust input EQ and pad to design tilt and output. Conventional AGC pad=pilot output−29dB.
Record corrected pilot output,select S1=3 and match AGC output; verify no change between setup and AGC after settling.
Balance reverse against approved receive reference,restore design pads and record final sweep.
gaps: Original manufacturer PDF is unavailable; historical manufacturer-authored copy is labeled. Detailed values must match the installed module/control.
Do not reuse these conventional AGC pad/backoff steps for ACI DSIM.

gm-hgd.qualification: Minimum operational gain; auto/thermal,10.5dB interstage EQ,20C,0dB input EQ/1dB pad. Reverse includes 1dB output pad; optional reverse switch costs0.5dB. Not a flat frequency curve.

gm-le.qualification: Operational gain not labeled minimum. Manual9dB ISEQ;thermal7.5dB ISEQ;AGC9dB ISEQ. Reference 20C,0dB input EQ/1dB pad. No arbitrary marker gain implied.

gm-hgbt.qualification: Minimum operational gain for auto/thermal10.5dB ISEQ; selected output and settings matter.

gm-ubt.qualification: Main output is the lower-level trunk path; auxiliary outputs have separate gain. AGC calculation uses main-port pilot output.

gm-lgd.qualification: 65/86 split only; minimum operational gain at stated reference configuration.

gm-gan.qualification: Existing44/19.5dB scalar values cannot be freshly confirmed from this live URL. Preserve historical/unverified label; do not promote to available marker gain.

aoi-hgd.qualification: Minimum operational reference,0dB input EQ/1dB pad,20C. Reverse specification footnote4 is204MHz split only. Other split reverse gain remains unknown. HGD signal director affects output-specific gain.

aoi-hgbt.qualification: Minimum operational reference,0dB input EQ/1dB pad,20C. Reverse performance footnote4 is204MHz split only. Output reference table extraction has ambiguous formatting; do not turn it into fixed operating targets.

aoi-le.qualification: Minimum operational reference,0dB input EQ/1dB pad,20C. Reverse footnote4 is204MHz split only. Spanish table has some unit/label typos; do not apply an ambiguous cell as a universal spec.

aoi-ba.qualification: 0dB pad,15dB minimum at1.8GHz,not a flat band value. Source has1791/1794MHz endpoint differences and an unsigned20dB forward test-point row. Reverse6dB@684MHz is not verified gain at204MHz. Retain entered marker gains.
